description:
Casting time: 1 hour.

You enchant a creature, object, or an area no larger than 200 ft in any dimension. Choose Attraction or Repulsion, choose a creature type, and roll Spirit to set the spell's Difficulty.

For the next 10 days, creatures of the chosen type that come within Long Range of the target must roll Spirit against the Difficulty. On a pass, the creature is unaffected. On a failure, the effect depends on the choice you made:

  • Attraction: The creature cannot willingly move away from the target and will move toward it if possible.

  • Repulsion: The creature cannot willingly approach the target and will move away from it if possible.

The effect lasts while the creature remains within Long Range of the target.

Instead of choosing a creature type, you may choose a particular person or group of people.

Describe the effects of the spell.
name: Magnetism
successes:
✨: The spell's effects extend out to Far Range.

🌞: The spell's effects last indefinitely, until you spend an Action to end it.
